newsitem.title: DUBAI: GM says Gulf Caprice sales up 20 pct in Q4.
newsitem.headline: GM says Gulf Caprice sales up 20 pct in Q4.

text.p: General Motors said Gulf sales of the Chevrolet Caprice, which it called the most successful American car in the Middle East, rose 20 percent in the last quarter of 1996 compared to the previous three months.
In a statement, it said 3,150 Caprices were sold in the six Gulf countries in the fourth quarter, 519 more than in the third quarter and 505 more than in the last three months of 1995.
"Throughout the GCC countries this year we expect to sell around 12,000 of the Caprice Classic LS, the LT and the more sporty Caprice SS," said Alan Batey, GM's Middle East director.
The Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) is made up of Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Bahrain, United Arab Emirates, Oman and Qatar. It is GM's biggest export market.
